-PumPum NS features Local Multiplayer and Endless game modes as well as countless amount of improvements.

-What makes it unique? 
-You won't find other games with sexy naked animated girls and boobs on NSwitch! The game is unique. It took a long time to discuss the content with Nintendo and thankfully they allowed the game to be released.

-Because it has more girls! Almost ALL of the girls from the PumPum DLC are included in the default NSwitch version. And, of course, don't miss out on the pre-order discount!

-No naked breasts for Japanese, Korean and Hong Kong players?
-Unfortunately, that kind of stuff is not allowed by local regulators and Nintendo.

-What about Germany and Australia?
-Don't blame me, blame your governments.

notes.title: New Games Announcement!
notes.content:
[url=url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1595290?utm_source=e1i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342831/7a0bb554dd4a2acd4954248f4beda02486466198.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]Greetings everyone, how you doing?! I have great news for you!

I'm so happy and excited to let you know that I'm going to release two new games in 2023: [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2192270?utm_source=e1]PumPum 2[/url][/u][/b] and [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191080]Poozle[/url][/u][/b]!

Both of them will be released in Q1 of 2023. The games are half-finished, and there's still plenty of work to do, but I'm very satisfied with how they look for now.

Please keep in mind that the games are still in development and some of the content (like screenshots, trailer or description) is subject to change.

I'm also looking for people who can translate text from these games into new languages. If you are willing to help, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/ShmoopsGames/]PM[/url] me. For those who are wondering why I don't want to hire a professional translator: you are the most motivated, creative and possibly obscene translators I can find! There is not so much text for translation, about half an A4 page.

Stay tuned!

Cheers and Merry Christmas!
[/h3]

notes.title: First update - EASIER levels, minor bug fixed
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes:

[olist]
[*] The game is now easier to play! Smaller levels, more hints!
[*] Achevements are working 
[*] New game mode! After you complete the last level, the Challenge mode with a leaderboard will be unlocked.
[*] Spanish language enabled on Steam Page
[*] Other minor bugs fixed, GUI improved
[/olist]

I'm also working on DLC compatibility so expect another update in a week or so!

The Challenge mode has an infinite number of levels. You start with a zero score. Each time you complete a level, you get more score points, the faster you did it - the more you get.
The score is sent to the leaderboard each time you complete a level.
